text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week and Grass Wonder!
Whoooo, which one is the strongest?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Should we leave out Seiun Sky?
It seems she wasn't able to train much due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, personally, I'd say no~. You can't just ignore the effects of that injury after all... Unfortunate as it is."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"—Looks like a lot of people think
there's no way Sei-chan can win~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I might rate it that way too.
Compared to those two who've trained steadily, I'd probably pale in comparison.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See, told you so~. No matter what I do,
I can't become the favorite Umamusume~. *sob*

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely what makes it such a fun, chaotic race, though♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha~♪ Of course!
Just watch and see what I have in store next!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Wherever the wind takes me, fancy-free.
I'm off!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
Just leave it all to Sei-chan~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it waaaay more thrilling
than you could ever imagine, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
If it's her,
she might just put on an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sure...
If it's her...—!
